description: This source file implements a simple sample server for the RBUS framework. It includes handlers for get and set operations on a data string, a callback for message processing, and code to register objects and methods with the RBUS broker.

methods.description: Handles set requests by updating the data string with the provided payload.

methods.description: Generic callback that logs received messages and invokes handle_unknown.
